ctx.x: And then it began to -- my throat began to bother me. I began to -- it began to bother me to swallow, and I said, "Oh, my God, what is this?" So finally I said to my husband, I said, "Listen, my throat is bothering me. It bothers me to swallow." So he said, "Well, you'd better go to the doctor." And I didn't want to go back to the dentist. I didn't want to go back there and I didn't dare tell my husband what the dentist had told me. I said, "No, I can't go back." So he said, "Well, you'd better go to the doctor."…

So I called my doctor, who was Dr. Mermillion at that time. Not Dr. Mermillion, I don't mean that. What am I talking about. No, this was Dr. Hardiman. Dr. Hardiman was my dentist. So I went to Dr. Hardiman -- I called Dr. Hardiman, rather, and I told him that I had to come in and see him. He says, "Oh, is that so?" He said, "Oh, is that so?" I said, "Yes, Doctor, I've got to see you as soon as possible." So he made, you know, an appointment for me to see him, and I got in there and he looked at me. He says, "I…

"You've waited two years and I told you to come back in two weeks." And so I said, "Yes, well it didn't bother me, it didn't hurt." And he said, "But I knew it was going to hurt. I told you then it was a very serious thing, but I wasn't able to strike the tooth before because it was infected so." So he says, "Now, you're in a heck of a fix." He says, "Now, the only thing I can tell you now is you're going to have to go to the hospital." So he called the hospital, and I got to thinking about this. So my husband…
